title: Satwik-Chirag Conquer China Masters, Set Tone for Asiad Title Defence
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair secured a significant title, boosting their confidence ahead of their Asian Games title defence.
summary: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty rallied from a game down to beat China’s He Ji Ting and Ren Xiang Yu, claiming their second title of the season and setting a strong precedent for the upcoming Asian Games.

title: Satwik-Chirag Storm into Third China Masters Final
indian_angle: India's premier men's doubles pair showcased strong form by reaching their third China Masters final, signaling their intent for the title.
summary: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty defeated their Malaysian rivals in three games to advance to the final of the China Masters, aiming for their second title of the year.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course signifies BAI's commitment to developing coaching talent within India, crucial for nurturing future badminton stars.
summary: The Badminton Association of India announced a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course to be held at the National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: The coaching camp at Guwahati prepares India's promising young talent for international junior championships, fostering future champions.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change by BAI for domestic junior events aims to modernize play and align with potential international trends, impacting young Indian players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
